name: ballerina/soap
description: This module offers a set of APIs that facilitate the transmission of XML requests to a SOAP backend. It excels in managing security policies within SOAP requests, ensuring the transmission of secured SOAP envelopes. Moreover, it possesses the capability to efficiently extract data from security-applied SOAP responses.

fields.name: outboundSecurity
fields.description: Web service security configurations for SOAP requests

fields.name: inboundSecurity
fields.description: Web service security configurations to decrypt and verify SOAP responses

typeDefs.name: OutboundSecurityConfig
typeDefs.description: Union type of all the outbound web service security configurations.

typeDefs.name: InboundSecurityConfig
typeDefs.description: Represents the record for outbound security configurations to verify and decrypt SOAP envelopes.

fields.name: decryptKeystore
fields.description: The keystore to decrypt the SOAP envelope

fields.name: signatureKeystore
fields.description: The keystore to verify the signature of the SOAP envelope

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Defines the common error type for the module.

typeDefs.name: PasswordType
typeDefs.description: Represents enums for all the supported password types.

typeDefs.name: EncryptionAlgorithm

typeDefs.name: CanonicalizationAlgorithm
